text:
infra-monitor: :rotating_light: ALERT: SJC3 control-plane heartbeat missing for 35s, API endpoint 10.3.4.1 unresponsive. Detected by cluster-health-checker.

alex: ack. seeing lots of 502s from hosted API in SJC3 via synthetic checks.

maria: on it, starting quick kube and node checks.

devon: is this a networking flap or node-side panic? any provider incident posted?

infra-monitor: provider event https://status-cloud.example.com/INC-9832 -> "network fabric instability" (SJC region). ETA unknown.

maria: running: ```kubectl --context=sjc3 get nodes -o wide
NAME           STATUS     ROLES    AGE   VERSION
g-node-12      NotReady   gpu      12d   v1.25.4
g-node-13      NotReady   gpu      12d   v1.25.4
ctrl-1         Unknown    master   14d   v1.25.4
```

alex: ctrl plane Unknown. That matches heartbeat loss. We should consider traffic cutover.

sre-oncall: agree. what's current spare capacity in west-us for GPU workloads?

leo: dedicated-spare-pool has 24x A100 slots in IAD1 and 8x in LAX2. Utilization: IAD1 60%, LAX2 85%.

katy: we have pre-baked failover plan: shift control-plane traffic to IAD1 control-plane replica + re-route model-serving traffic to nearest healthy regions with capacity fallback. This will spike cross-region egress costs and add ~30-40% token cost for affected requests. Confirm?

devon: confirmed, better to accept cost than >10min outage. Does redirect preserve data plane for private deployments?

maria: private deployments in SJC3 will be degraded; we'll send customers an FYI. For hosted API, we can do gradual shift. Starting with 10% -> 50% -> 100% with health checks.

infra-monitor: cookup plan: 1) enable route override -> traffic-shift policy "sjc3-evac-2026" to route to iad1 & lax2; 2) scale up dedicated spare pool in iad1 by +12 nodes; 3) set model-serving fallback to quantized small-model variants for non-enterprise tenants to reduce memory.

alex: make the policy and run canary now. katy, can you take routing? maria, run scale up. I'll open incident bridge.

katy: applying policy: ```rms route apply --policy sjc3-evac-2026 --regions iad1,lax2 --weights 10,90 --health-check /healthz``` -> response queued.

maria: scaling: ```cloudctl compute resize --pool dedicated-spare-iad1 --add 12 --type a100``` -> submitted, provisioning started (eta ~4m).

devon: verifying model fallbacks: updating model-routing config to prefer quantized-llama-7b for non-prod tenants.

sre-oncall: creating status banner for affected customers and tagging enterprise accounts. Alex, bridge details?

alex: bridge link https://meet.example.com/incident-1945678901. Posting to ops-status.

infra-monitor: monitoring: control-plane heartbeat still missing in SJC3, now 92% of SJC3 API requests failing. New region errors: increased latency in LAX2 by +18ms since routing change started.

katy: canaries show iad1 healthy, lax2 high CPU but serving ok. Increasing weight to 40/60 now.

maria: provisioning reports 8/12 nodes up. GPU driver init pending on 4.

leo: note: if we push >60% to LAX2 we'll hit quota; keep an eye. Also potential spot reclaim risk.

alex: good call. devon, add autoscale guardrails to avoid oversubscribe.

devon: set autoscale max to preserve 20% headroom in target regions. Command run.

sre-oncall: posting incident summary to #customers-ops: short blurb + mitigation steps.

katy: routing weight now 40 iad1 / 60 lax2. monitoring for errors for next 5m.

infra-monitor: alert update: SJC3 control-plane still unreachable at 1945678958, provider escalated to network engineering.

alex: thanks team. keeping bridge open. we'll update every 10m or on major changes. :white_check_mark:
